name: Music Hub Sync
author: anton
description: Sends Navidrome play history to Music Hub (stats, Rewind), runs scans for its downloads and hearts songs it queues (Plex loved tracks).

hubUrl.title: Music Hub URL
hubUrl.description: Address of Music Hub as seen from the Navidrome container

secret.title: Ingest secret
secret.description: Must match INGEST_SECRET of Music Hub

http.reason: Send play history to Music Hub on the local network

users.reason: Sync every user's play history; an admin user is needed to start scans

scheduler.reason: Run the sync every few minutes

kvstore.reason: Remember the last synced play per user

subsonicapi.reason: Start Navidrome scans of folders Music Hub downloaded into and heart songs it queues (needs an admin user assigned)
